methods.name: Same-stream percentile anomaly
methods.purpose: Weather/soil anomaly vs field's own same-time-of-year history
methods.inputs: one homogeneous daily series; +/-7 d DOY window; current year excluded; >=15 years; 1991-2020
methods.notes: Never mix products between baseline and current value; label near-real-time tails 'estimated'.

methods.name: SPI-3/6 gamma fit
methods.notes: climate_indices clips at +/-3.09; own scipy SPI unclipped (r 0.998-0.999).

methods.name: S2 one-call masked polygon statistics
methods.inputs: PC data API item/statistics; expressions where(clear,ndvi,0);clear*1.0
methods.notes: -1000 DN when processing_baseline>=04.00 (PC) / always (Earth Search c1). Skip clear fraction <0.5. SCL 3 not clear.

methods.name: MODIS portfolio-window COG prefetch + QA-masked polygon median
methods.inputs: PC modis-13Q1-061 + CMR inventory diff + ORNL backfill
methods.notes: reliability 0/1; strict VI_Quality; good fraction >=0.5; report n_years per composite; mask pre-clearing years.

methods.name: S2-to-MODIS cross-calibration
methods.inputs: S2 16-day max composites (B8A) aligned to MOD13Q1 dates
methods.notes: Pooled Theil-Sen MODIS = 0.940*S2 + 0.048 (R2 0.899, RMSE 0.050, n=308); per farm when >=30 pairs.

methods.name: Weighted Whittaker smoother
methods.inputs: daily grid at acquisition day; QA weights 1/0.5/0
methods.notes: lambda 500 (or SG 5,2). No upper envelope on cropland. Flag values >32 d from good obs as gap-filled.

methods.name: Hold last good observation (as-of NDVI)
methods.inputs: last clear MODIS or calibrated S2
methods.notes: Never worse than extrapolation; label 'estimated' after 16 d.

methods.name: NDVI z-score with persistence
methods.inputs: smoothed curve, DOY +/-8 d, other years
methods.notes: 2 consecutive composites or 32-day mean z; sd floor ~0.05 (proposed, untested).

methods.name: FAO-56 single bucket
methods.inputs: CHIRPS precip + ETo + SoilGrids TAW + Kc

methods.name: refet FAO-56 ETo

methods.name: ERA5 to CHIRPS quantile mapping
methods.notes: Flood tail fails out of sample; do not use for flood72hMm.

methods.notes: Design input; would gate ADR-0001 irrigated x0.4 drought weighting. Decree sets floor at 'watch'.
